description:
The plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” with tick labels “Layer1-4”, “Layer5-12”, “Layer13-20”, “Layer21-28”, and “Layer29-32”, representing discrete layer groupings. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” with a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. 

A yellow line, marked with circular data points, represents “LB-Avg of 2xTokens,8-bit”, starting at approximately 1.5% at “Layer1-4” and decreasing to approximately -10% at “Layer13-20”, then increasing to approximately -7% at “Layer29-32”. A red line, marked with square data points, represents “LB-Avg of 1xTokens,8-bit”, beginning at approximately 0.5% at “Layer1-4” and decreasing to approximately -12% at “Layer13-20”, then increasing to approximately -8% at “Layer29-32”. A light blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “RULER4k of 2xTokens,8-bit”, starting at approximately 2% at “Layer1-4” and decreasing to approximately -25% at “Layer13-20”, then increasing to approximately -15% at “Layer29-32”. A dark blue line, marked with square data points, represents “RULER4k of 1xTokens,16-bit”, beginning at approximately 1% at “Layer1-4” and decreasing to approximately -22% at “Layer13-20”, then increasing to approximately -13% at “Layer29-32”. A gray dashed line represents “Baseline of 4xTokens,4-bit” and remains relatively constant at approximately 0% across all layer groupings.
